name: Kawanishi (Niigata, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kawanishi town emblem in white: a stylised bud-like device of curved strokes enclosing a character.
history: Flag of the former town of Kawanishi in Niigata Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-04-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 8 June 1968.

features.role: Kawanishi town emblem — a stylised bud-like device of curved strokes enclosing a character
